html:
The Italian invasion of Albania began on 7 April 1939, Good Friday, when Italian troops landed at Durrës and other ports and took the country within days.

Mussolini wanted a victory to match Hitler's seizure of Prague and already controlled much of Albania's economy. A few hundred Albanians resisted at Durrës. King Zog fled, and King Victor Emmanuel III of Italy took the Albanian crown. In 1940 Italy used Albania to invade Greece, a disaster that drew Germany into the Balkans. Italy added Kosovo to its Albania in 1941. After Italy's surrender in 1943 Germany took over, and the communist Partisans of Enver Hoxha took power in 1944.
sum: The Italian invasion of Albania began on 7 April 1939, Good Friday, when Italian troops landed at Durrës and other ports and took the country within days.
